name: Security Audit
description: Review local code changes for security regressions, trace dangerous defaults to their enforcement points, and find variants of a known vulnerability. Three read-only skills adapted from Trail of Bits, with evidence, trigger conditions and confidence limits for each finding.
examples: Review local main...HEAD for security regressions. Trace changed trust boundaries and callers; cite path:line, evidence, trigger conditions and confidence. Do not change files.
Audit this repository for fail-open defaults. Trace missing, empty and invalid configuration through startup to security decisions; separate reachable issues from uncertain candidates.
The removed ownership check in this diff was a bug. Find other instances of the same root cause in this local repository, and explain why similar-looking guarded cases are safe.

zh-CN.name: 安全审计
zh-CN.description: 审查本地代码变更中的安全回归，追踪危险默认值到安全决策点，并查找已知漏洞的同类实例。基于 Trail of Bits 适配的三个只读 Skills，每条结论包含证据、触发条件与置信边界。
examples: 审查本地 main...HEAD 的安全回归，追踪变更的信任边界与调用方，给出路径行号、证据、触发条件与置信度，不修改文件。
审计当前仓库中安全控制默认放行的问题，追踪配置缺失、空值和无效值从启动到安全决策的过程，区分可达漏洞与待核实项。
这份 diff 中移除的所有权校验已确认有漏洞。查找本地仓库里相同根因的其他实例，并说明相似代码中哪些有有效保护。
